source: NRCRI nke di na Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrụ ugbo ga manoma koko

answer: Nke a bụ ndụmọdụ m maka ọrụ ugbo koko na koko: kụọ osisi ndò dịka plantain. Nke a na-enyere aka n'ihi na sachaa ugbo mgbe niile. fesa jan karfe fungicide maka mgbochi black pod.

question: Ụtụtụ ọma. Ahụrụ m ntutu ọcha na akwụkwọ na yorobo m. Kedu ọrịa nke a bụ?
answer: onion downy mildew na-emebi ihe ọkụkụ gị. Ọ na-agbasa site na fungus na-agbasa n'oge mmiri. Ngwọta: belata ọnụọgụ mmiri. kụọ mkpụrụ na-eguzogide ọrịa.
source: NRCRI nke di na Umudike, ndụmọdụ nchọpụta ọrịa ga manoma yorobo

question: Ezigbo ụbọchị. Ahụrụ m ntụpọ aja aja n'elu akwụkwọ na akidi m. Kedu ọrịa nke a bụ?
answer: early leaf spot (Cercospora arachidicola) na-emebi ihe ọkụkụ gị. Ọ na-agbasa site na fungus na-adị ndụ n'ime ihe mkpofu ugbo. Ngwọta: fesa fungicide na mbido ngosipụta. gbanwee ihe ọkụkụ ugbo ruo afọ 2.
source: NRCRI nke di na Umudike, ndụmọdụ nchọpụta ọrịa ga manoma akidi

question: Ụtụtụ ọma. Achọrọ m ịmata otu m ga-esi  owuwe ihe ubi na nchekwa n'ugbo agwa m. Gịnị ka ị ga-adụ m ọdụ?
answer: Nke a bụ ndụmọdụ m maka  owuwe ihe ubi na nchekwa na agwa:  ọwụ ihe ubi mgbe mkpụrụ kpọrọ nkụ. Nke a na-enyere aka n'ihi na chekwa na akpa na-egbochi ikuku (PICS bags). chebe site na bruchid weevils na nchekwa.
source: NRCRI nke di na Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrụ ugbo ga manoma agwa

question: Ezigbo ụbọchị. Ahụrụ m ntụpọ ojii na akwụkwọ na ọnwụ osisi vine na ji m. Kedu ọrịa nke a bụ?
answer: yam anthracnose (Colletotrichum gloeosporioides) na-emebi ihe ọkụkụ gị. Ọ na-agbasa site na fungus na-agbasa n'oge mmiri ozuzo. Ngwọta: jiri mkpụrụ na-eguzogide dịka TDr 95/19177. akpọla n'ala juru mmiri.
source: NRCRI nke di na Umudike, ndụmọdụ nchọpụta ọrịa ga manoma ji

question: Kedu. Achọrọ m ịmata otu m ga-esi nhọrọ nke yankan rogo n'ugbo akpu m. Gịnị ka ị ga-adụ m ọdụ?
answer: Nke a bụ ndụmọdụ m maka nhọrọ nke yankan rogo na akpu: jiri ihe ọkụkụ ahụike ogologo 20-25cm na nodes 5-7. Nke a na-enyere aka n'ihi na kụọ n'akụkụ 45-digiri. ihe ọkụkụ na-arịa ọrịa sitere na ụlọ nyocha.
source: NRCRI nke di na Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrụ ugbo ga manoma akpu

question: Ụtụtụ ọma. Ahụrụ m ntụpọ ntụ n'elu akwụkwọ ala na oka m. Kedu ọrịa nke a bụ?
answer: gray leaf spot (Cercospora zeae-maydis) na-emebi ihe ọkụkụ gị. Ọ na-agbasa site na spores fungal n'ime ihe mkpofu ugbo. Ngwọta: fesa mancozeb kwa izu 2. na-abawanye n'oge okpomọkụ na mmiri.
source: NRCRI nke di na Umudike, ndụmọdụ nchọpụta ọrịa ga manoma oka

question: Kedu. tomato m nwere nsogbu — oghere n'akwụkwọ na-ahapụ naanị akpụkpọ. Kedu ụdị ahụhụ nke a bụ, gịnị ka m ga-eme?
answer: tomato leaf miner (Tuta absoluta) na-akpata nsogbu n'ubi gị. moth na-agbasa ngwa ngwa. Ihe ị ga-eme: jiri ọnyà pheromone na fesa neem. Echefula — ọ nwere ike imebi ugbo ni izu 2 na-enweghị ọgwụgwọ.
source: NRCRI nke di na Umudike, ndụmọdụ nchịkwa ahụhụ ga manoma tomato

question: Ezigbo ụbọchị. Achọrọ m ịmata otu m ga-esi kụọ alubosa n'ugbo yorobo m. Gịnị ka ị ga-adụ m ọdụ?
answer: Nke a bụ ndụmọdụ m maka kụọ alubosa na yorobo: kụọ mkpụrụ ozugbo ma ọ bụ site na nursery. Nke a na-enyere aka n'ihi na kwụsị 20cm n'etiti ahịrị, 10cm n'etiti ihe ọkụkụ. alubosa chọrọ anyanwụ nke ukwuu.
source: NRCRI nke di na Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrụ ugbo ga manoma yorobo

question: Ụtụtụ ọma. Achọrọ m ịmata otu m ga-esi nlekọta osisi kọfị n'ugbo kofi m. Gịnị ka ị ga-adụ m ọdụ?
answer: Nke a bụ ndụmọdụ m maka nlekọta osisi kọfị na kofi: chapụ alaka ochie. Nke a na-enyere aka n'ihi na tinye fatịlaịza organic kwa afọ. nọgide ndò dị mma.
source: NRCRI nke di na Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrụ ugbo ga manoma kofi

question: Ezigbo ụbọchị. Ahụrụ m ntụpọ mmiri n'elu akwụkwọ na mkpụrụ na agwa m. Kedu ọrịa nke a bụ?
answer: common bacterial blight na-emebi ihe ọkụkụ gị. Ọ na-agbasa site na nje na-agbasa site n' mmiri ozuzo. Ngwọta: arụla ọrụ n'ugbo mgbe akwụkwọ juru mmiri. jiri mkpụrụ na-eguzogide ọrịa.
source: NRCRI nke di na Umudike, ndụmọdụ nchọpụta ọrịa ga manoma agwa

question: Kedu. Achọrọ m ịmata otu m ga-esi ọrụ ugbo dawa n'ugbo sorghum m. Gịnị ka ị ga-adụ m ọdụ?
answer: Nke a bụ ndụmọdụ m maka ọrụ ugbo dawa na sorghum: kụọ mkpụrụ na omimi 3-5cm. Nke a na-enyere aka n'ihi na kwụsị 75cm n'etiti ahịrị, 20cm n'etiti ihe ọkụkụ. dawa na-eguzogide ọkọchị karịa ọka.
source: NRCRI nke di na Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrụ ugbo ga manoma sorghum

question: Kedu. Achọrọ m ịmata otu m ga-esi mmiri n'ugbo tomato m. Gịnị ka ị ga-adụ m ọdụ?
answer: Nke a bụ ndụmọdụ m maka mmiri na tomato: nye mmiri na ntọala ihe ọkụkụ, ghara ịgbanye akwụkwọ mmiri. Nke a na-enyere aka n'ihi na belata mmiri mgbe mkpụrụ osisi malitere eto. drip irrigation ka mma.

answer: cassava green mite (Mononychellus tanajoa) na-akpata nsogbu n'ubi gị. mites na-agbasa n'oge ọkọchị. Ihe ị ga-eme: fesa mmanụ neem ma ọ bụ acaricide. Echefula — ọrịa siri ike na-ebelata rogo site na 60%.

answer: millet head miner (Heliocheilus albipunctella) na-akpata nsogbu n'ubi gị. ahụhụ moth nke gero pearl. Ihe ị ga-eme: kụọ ọsọ iji zere oge ahụhụ. Echefula — jiri mkpụrụ na-eguzogide dịka ZATIP.

answer: amaranth stem borer na-akpata nsogbu n'ubi gị. larvae moth na-egwu oghere n'ime mgbọrọgwụ. Ihe ị ga-eme: fesa mmanụ neem. Echefula — wepụ ihe ọkụkụ butere ọrịa.
source: NRCRI nke di na Umudike, ndụmọdụ nchịkwa ahụhụ ga manoma green

answer: black sigatoka (Mycosphaerella fijiensis) na-emebi ihe ọkụkụ gị. Ọ na-agbasa site na fungus na-agbasa site n'ifufe. Ngwọta: fesa fungicide mgbe niile. chapụ akwụkwọ butere ọrịa.

question: Ezigbo ụbọchị. Achọrọ m ịmata otu m ga-esi kụọ tii n'ugbo tii m. Gịnị ka ị ga-adụ m ọdụ?
answer: Nke a bụ ndụmọdụ m maka kụọ tii na tii: kụọ n'elu ala nwere mmiri mmiri. Nke a na-enyere aka n'ihi na kwụsị 1.5m n'etiti ihe ọkụkụ. chapụ mgbe niile maka eto ọhụrụ.
source: NRCRI nke di na Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrụ ugbo ga manoma tii

question: Ndewo. oka m nwere nsogbu — akwụkwọ na-akpọnwụ n'etiti. Kedu ụdị ahụhụ nke a bụ, gịnị ka m ga-eme?
answer: stem borer (Busseola fusca) na-akpata nsogbu n'ubi gị. moth na-etinye akwa n'azụ akwụkwọ. Ihe ị ga-eme: fesa carbofuran mgbe ihe ọkụkụ ruru ogologo ikpere. Echefula — ikpuru na-emebi mgbọrọgwụ site n'ime.
source: NRCRI nke di na Umudike, ndụmọdụ nchịkwa ahụhụ ga manoma oka

question: Nnọọ. Achọrọ m ịmata otu m ga-esi fatịlaịza nke oge a n'ugbo oka m. Gịnị ka ị ga-adụ m ọdụ?
answer: Nke a bụ ndụmọdụ m maka fatịlaịza nke oge a na oka: tinye NPK 15-15-15 mgbe izu 2-3 gasịrị ịkụ. Nke a na-enyere aka n'ihi na tinye urea mgbe ihe ọkụkụ ruru ogologo ikpere. fatịlaịza dị ukwu na-adọta stem borers.
source: NRCRI nke di na Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrụ ugbo ga manoma oka

question: Kedu. mangolo m nwere nsogbu — obere oghere na mkpụrụ osisi na ikpuru n'ime. Kedu ụdị ahụhụ nke a bụ, gịnị ka m ga-eme?
answer: mango fruit fly (Bactrocera dorsalis) na-akpata nsogbu n'ubi gị. nwanyị weevil na-etinye akwa n'okpuru akpụkpọ. Ihe ị ga-eme: jiri ọnyà pheromone (methyl eugenol). Echefula — nakọta mkpụrụ ndị dara ma lie ha omimi.
source: NRCRI nke di na Umudike, ndụmọdụ nchịkwa ahụhụ ga manoma mangolo

question: Kedu. agwa m nwere nsogbu — akwụkwọ gbagọrọ na mmanụ aṅụ na-enwu. Kedu ụdị ahụhụ nke a bụ, gịnị ka m ga-eme?
answer: cowpea aphid (Aphis craccivora) na-akpata nsogbu n'ubi gị. aphids na-agbakọta n'elu obere akwụkwọ. Ihe ị ga-eme: fesa mmiri neem ma ọ bụ ncha igbu ahụhụ. Echefula — aphids na-ebufe mosaic virus.

question: Ụtụtụ ọma. Ahụrụ m ihe ọkụkụ gbara akpụ na akwụkwọ na-agbakọta na akidi m. Kedu ọrịa nke a bụ?
answer: groundnut rosette virus na-emebi ihe ọkụkụ gị. Ọ na-agbasa site na aphids na-ebufe ya, enweghị ọgwụ kemịkal. Ngwọta: jiri mkpụrụ na-eguzogide dịka SAMNUT 24. kwatuo ma ọkụ ihe ọkụkụ butere ọrịa ahụ.

answer: onion purple blotch (Alternaria porri) na-emebi ihe ọkụkụ gị. Ọ na-agbasa site na fungus Alternaria porri. Ngwọta: fesa mancozeb kwa ụbọchị 10. gbanwee ihe ọkụkụ ugbo site na allium ruo afọ 3.

source: NRCRI nke di na Umudike, ndụmọdụ nchọpụta ọrịa ga manoma mmiri ara

question: Ndewo. unere m nwere nsogbu — akwụkwọ gbagọrọ na aphids n'ala. Kedu ụdị ahụhụ nke a bụ, gịnị ka m ga-eme?
answer: banana aphid (Pentalonia nigronervosa) na-akpata nsogbu n'ubi gị. aphids na-ebufe bunchy top virus. Ihe ị ga-eme: fesa ncha igbu ahụhụ. Echefula — wepụ ihe ọkụkụ butere ọrịa ahụ.
source: NRCRI nke di na Umudike, ndụmọdụ nchịkwa ahụhụ ga manoma unere

question: Nnọọ. mangolo m nwere nsogbu — obere oghere na mkpụrụ osisi na ikpuru n'ime. Kedu ụdị ahụhụ nke a bụ, gịnị ka m ga-eme?
answer: mango fruit fly (Bactrocera dorsalis) na-akpata nsogbu n'ubi gị. nwanyị weevil na-etinye akwa n'okpuru akpụkpọ. Ihe ị ga-eme: jiri ọnyà pheromone (methyl eugenol). Echefula — nakọta mkpụrụ ndị dara ma lie ha omimi.
source: NRCRI nke di na Umudike, ndụmọdụ nchịkwa ahụhụ ga manoma mangolo

question: Ezigbo ụbọchị. Ahụrụ m akwụkwọ odo na ịkpa ike na nduku m. Kedu ọrịa nke a bụ?
answer: sweet potato virus disease (SPVD) na-emebi ihe ọkụkụ gị. Ọ na-agbasa site na whiteflies na aphids na-ebufe ya. Ngwọta: jiri vines na-arịa ọrịa. wepụ ihe ọkụkụ butere ọrịa.
source: NRCRI nke di na Umudike, ndụmọdụ nchọpụta ọrịa ga manoma nduku

question: Ndewo. Achọrọ m ịmata otu m ga-esi kụọ agwa n'ugbo agwa m. Gịnị ka ị ga-adụ m ọdụ?
answer: Nke a bụ ndụmọdụ m maka kụọ agwa na agwa: kụọ mkpụrụ na omimi 3-5cm. Nke a na-enyere aka n'ihi na kwụsị 50cm n'etiti ahịrị, 10cm n'etiti ihe ọkụkụ. wake na-edozi nitrogen n'ala.
source: NRCRI nke di na Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrụ ugbo ga manoma agwa

question: Ndewo. Achọrọ m ịmata otu m ga-esi kụọ ogede n'ugbo ogidi m. Gịnị ka ị ga-adụ m ọdụ?
answer: Nke a bụ ndụmọdụ m maka kụọ ogede na ogidi: kụọ suckers ahụike sitere na isi ntụkwasị obi. Nke a na-enyere aka n'ihi na kwụsị 3m n'etiti ihe ọkụkụ. tinye mulch iji chekwaa mmiri.
source: NRCRI nke di na Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrụ ugbo ga manoma ogidi

question: Ndewo. Ahụrụ m ntụpọ mmiri n'elu akwụkwọ na-atụgharị aja aja na agwa m. Kedu ọrịa nke a bụ?
answer: cowpea bacterial blight na-emebi ihe ọkụkụ gị. Ọ na-agbasa site na mmiri ozuzo na-ebufe nje ahụ. Ngwọta: tinye ọgwụ jan karfe (copper fungicide). jiri mkpụrụ na-arịa ọrịa a kwadoro.
source: NRCRI nke di na Umudike, ndụmọdụ nchọpụta ọrịa ga manoma agwa

question: Ụtụtụ ọma. Achọrọ m ịmata otu m ga-esi kụọ okwuru n'ugbo okwuru m. Gịnị ka ị ga-adụ m ọdụ?
answer: Nke a bụ ndụmọdụ m maka kụọ okwuru na okwuru: kụọ mkpụrụ na omimi 2-3cm. Nke a na-enyere aka n'ihi na kwụsị 60cm n'etiti ahịrị, 30cm n'etiti ihe ọkụkụ. okwuru chọrọ anyanwụ na ala dị mma.
source: NRCRI nke di na Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrụ ugbo ga manoma okwuru

question: Ezigbo ụbọchị. Achọrọ m ịmata otu m ga-esi fatịlaịza nke oge a n'ugbo oka m. Gịnị ka ị ga-adụ m ọdụ?
answer: Nke a bụ ndụmọdụ m maka fatịlaịza nke oge a na oka: tinye NPK 15-15-15 mgbe izu 2-3 gasịrị ịkụ. Nke a na-enyere aka n'ihi na tinye urea mgbe ihe ọkụkụ ruru ogologo ikpere. fatịlaịza dị ukwu na-adọta stem borers.
source: NRCRI nke di na Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrụ ugbo ga manoma oka

question: Nnọọ. nkwu m nwere nsogbu — ikpuru na-egwu oghere n'ime okporo osisi na-eme ka ọ daa mbà. Kedu ụdị ahụhụ nke a bụ, gịnị ka m ga-eme?
answer: palm weevil (Rhynchophorus phoenicis) na-akpata nsogbu n'ubi gị. nnukwu ahụhụ na-abịa na mmerụ ahụ n'okporo osisi. Ihe ị ga-eme: zere imebi okporo osisi mgbe ị na-akpụ. Echefula — ọnyà pheromone maka nleba anya.
source: NRCRI nke di na Umudike, ndụmọdụ nchịkwa ahụhụ ga manoma nkwu

question: Nnọọ. Ahụrụ m ntụpọ odo-aja aja n'elu akwụkwọ na yorobo m. Kedu ọrịa nke a bụ?
answer: onion purple blotch (Alternaria porri) na-emebi ihe ọkụkụ gị. Ọ na-agbasa site na fungus Alternaria porri. Ngwọta: fesa mancozeb kwa ụbọchị 10. gbanwee ihe ọkụkụ ugbo site na allium ruo afọ 3.
source: NRCRI nke di na Umudike, ndụmọdụ nchọpụta ọrịa ga manoma yorobo

question: Nnọọ. Ahụrụ m ntụ ọcha na akwụkwọ na watermelon m. Kedu ọrịa nke a bụ?
answer: powdery mildew na-emebi ihe ọkụkụ gị. Ọ na-agbasa site na fungus na-agbasa n'oge ọkọchị. Ngwọta: fesa sulfur fungicide. belata ọnụọgụ mmiri n'elu akwụkwọ.
source: NRCRI nke di na Umudike, ndụmọdụ nchọpụta ọrịa ga manoma watermelon

question: Ndewo. mangolo m nwere nsogbu — obere oghere na mkpụrụ osisi na ikpuru n'ime. Kedu ụdị ahụhụ nke a bụ, gịnị ka m ga-eme?
answer: mango fruit fly (Bactrocera dorsalis) na-akpata nsogbu n'ubi gị. nwanyị weevil na-etinye akwa n'okpuru akpụkpọ. Ihe ị ga-eme: jiri ọnyà pheromone (methyl eugenol). Echefula — nakọta mkpụrụ ndị dara ma lie ha omimi.

question: Kedu. akidi m nwere nsogbu — oghere na mkpụrụ na mmebi mgbọrọgwụ. Kedu ụdị ahụhụ nke a bụ, gịnị ka m ga-eme?
answer: termites na-akpata nsogbu n'ubi gị. termites na-awakpo n'oge ọkọchị. Ihe ị ga-eme: tinye ntụ isi n'akụkụ ihe ọkụkụ. Echefula — sachaa ugbo site na mkpofu osisi.
source: NRCRI nke di na Umudike, ndụmọdụ nchịkwa ahụhụ ga manoma akidi

question: Ụtụtụ ọma. Ahụrụ m ntụ ọcha na okooko na akwụkwọ na kashu m. Kedu ọrịa nke a bụ?
answer: powdery mildew na-emebi ihe ọkụkụ gị. Ọ na-agbasa site na fungus na-egbochi mmepụta mkpụrụ osisi. Ngwọta: fesa sulfur fungicide. chapụ maka ifufe dị mma.
source: NRCRI nke di na Umudike, ndụmọdụ nchọpụta ọrịa ga manoma kashu

question: Ụtụtụ ọma. agwa m nwere nsogbu — akwụkwọ gbagọrọ na mmanụ aṅụ na-enwu. Kedu ụdị ahụhụ nke a bụ, gịnị ka m ga-eme?
answer: cowpea aphid (Aphis craccivora) na-akpata nsogbu n'ubi gị. aphids na-agbakọta n'elu obere akwụkwọ. Ihe ị ga-eme: fesa mmiri neem ma ọ bụ ncha igbu ahụhụ. Echefula — aphids na-ebufe mosaic virus.
source: NRCRI nke di na Umudike, ndụmọdụ nchịkwa ahụhụ ga manoma agwa

question: Ndewo. Ahụrụ m ntụpọ mmiri n'elu akwụkwọ na cotton m. Kedu ọrịa nke a bụ?
answer: bacterial blight (Xanthomonas campestris pv. malvacearum) na-emebi ihe ọkụkụ gị. Ọ na-agbasa site na nje na-agbasa site n' mmiri ozuzo. Ngwọta: jiri mkpụrụ na-arịa ọrịa. gbanwee ihe ọkụkụ ugbo ruo afọ 2.
source: NRCRI nke di na Umudike, ndụmọdụ nchọpụta ọrịa ga manoma cotton

question: Ezigbo ụbọchị. tomato m nwere nsogbu — oghere n'akwụkwọ na-ahapụ naanị akpụkpọ. Kedu ụdị ahụhụ nke a bụ, gịnị ka m ga-eme?
answer: tomato leaf miner (Tuta absoluta) na-akpata nsogbu n'ubi gị. moth na-agbasa ngwa ngwa. Ihe ị ga-eme: jiri ọnyà pheromone na fesa neem. Echefula — ọ nwere ike imebi ugbo ni izu 2 na-enweghị ọgwụgwọ.
source: NRCRI nke di na Umudike, ndụmọdụ nchịkwa ahụhụ ga manoma tomato

question: Ndewo. Achọrọ m ịmata otu m ga-esi ọrụ ugbo owu n'ugbo cotton m. Gịnị ka ị ga-adụ m ọdụ?
answer: Nke a bụ ndụmọdụ m maka ọrụ ugbo owu na cotton: kụọ na mmalite oge mmiri. Nke a na-enyere aka n'ihi na kwụsị 90cm n'etiti ahịrị, 30cm n'etiti ihe ọkụkụ. chapụ alaka nwụrụ anwụ iji belata ọrịa.
source: NRCRI nke di na Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrụ ugbo ga manoma cotton

question: Nnọọ. oka m nwere nsogbu — akwụkwọ na-akpọnwụ n'etiti. Kedu ụdị ahụhụ nke a bụ, gịnị ka m ga-eme?
answer: stem borer (Busseola fusca) na-akpata nsogbu n'ubi gị. moth na-etinye akwa n'azụ akwụkwọ. Ihe ị ga-eme: fesa carbofuran mgbe ihe ọkụkụ ruru ogologo ikpere. Echefula — ikpuru na-emebi mgbọrọgwụ site n'ime.
source: NRCRI nke di na Umudike, ndụmọdụ nchịkwa ahụhụ ga manoma oka

question: Ezigbo ụbọchị. Achọrọ m ịmata otu m ga-esi kụọ osikapa n'ugbo osikapa m. Gịnị ka ị ga-adụ m ọdụ?
answer: Nke a bụ ndụmọdụ m maka kụọ osikapa na osikapa: kụọ mkpụrụ na ahịrị 20cm ebe dị anya. Nke a na-enyere aka n'ihi na kwadebe ugbo nke ọma tupu ịkụ. kụọ na mmalite oge mmiri.
source: NRCRI nke di na Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrụ ugbo ga manoma osikapa

question: Ezigbo ụbọchị. Ahụrụ m ntụpọ ntụ n'elu akwụkwọ ala na oka m. Kedu ọrịa nke a bụ?
answer: gray leaf spot (Cercospora zeae-maydis) na-emebi ihe ọkụkụ gị. Ọ na-agbasa site na spores fungal n'ime ihe mkpofu ugbo. Ngwọta: fesa mancozeb kwa izu 2. na-abawanye n'oge okpomọkụ na mmiri.
source: NRCRI nke di na Umudike, ndụmọdụ nchọpụta ọrịa ga manoma oka

question: Nnọọ. agwa m nwere nsogbu — ihe ọkụkụ gbara akpụ na akwụkwọ odo. Kedu ụdị ahụhụ nke a bụ, gịnị ka m ga-eme?
answer: bean fly (Ophiomyia phaseoli) na-akpata nsogbu n'ubi gị. larvae fly na-egwu oghere n'ime mgbọrọgwụ. Ihe ị ga-eme: kụọ ọsọ iji zere oge weevil. Echefula — tinye mulch n'akụkụ ihe ọkụkụ.

question: Kedu. ogidi m nwere nsogbu — ikpuru na-egwu oghere n'ime corm na-eme osisi daa. Kedu ụdị ahụhụ nke a bụ, gịnị ka m ga-eme?
answer: banana weevil (Cosmopolites sordidus) na-akpata nsogbu n'ubi gị. nnukwu ahụhụ na-ezo n'ime ihe mkpofu ugbo. Ihe ị ga-eme: jiri ihe ọkụkụ dị ọcha (tissue culture). Echefula — jide nnukwu ahụhụ na akụkụ pseudostem.

question: Mbaaɗa. Mi yi'i puɗol ina yoora tawa anniyaaki e tumate am. Ɗume rafi woni ɗo'o?
answer: bacterial wilt (Ralstonia solanacearum) woni rafi bonnata ndemri maa. Ɗum saakitoo e kwayar cuta nder leydi. Nyawndam: waylitu ngal luumo duuɓi 3-4. ɓuuɗa aawɗe juriyeeje.
source: ILRI haa IAR Samaru, wasiyaji dow anndingo rafi ga manoma tumate

question: No wa'i. kohi am woodi caɗeele — ɓutte nder ɗaɗol e haakooji yoori. Ɗume ñoɓɓere woni ndee, ɗume mbaɗata?
answer: amaranth stem borer woni ko bonnata ndemri maa. larvae moth ina ɓutta nder ɗaɗol. Ko mbaɗata: fesa man neem. Woto yejjito — ittu puɗi cuuɗi.
source: ILRI haa IAR Samaru, wasiyaji dow haɓugo ñoɓɓe ga manoma kohi

question: No wa'i. Mi yi'i tolleeji boɗeeji dow haako e ɗaɗol e mbayeeri am. Ɗume rafi woni ɗo'o?
answer: anthracnose (Colletotrichum graminicola) woni rafi bonnata ndemri maa. Ɗum saakitoo e fungus ina ngooda nder tarkace luumo. Nyawndam: waylitu ngal luumo duuɓi 2. fesa fungicide nder saha piindi.
source: ILRI haa IAR Samaru, wasiyaji dow anndingo rafi ga manoma mbayeeri

question: Mbaaɗa. Miɗo yiɗi anndude no mi waɗirta ɓuuɗa kasu e ndemri kasu am. Ɗume wasiyiiji maa?
answer: Wasiyanke am dow ɓuuɗa kasu e kasu: ɓuuɗa e woɗɗaande 10m hakkunde leɗɗe. Ɗum wallitata sabo ƴaŋŋa takin organic. taƴa lisɗe maayɗe sahaa-sahaa.
